title: say in the reviewer brief that a -run pattern anchored with $ is denied, and give the anchored form to use instead

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-000049-2b18, project ork, item S574:

say in the reviewer brief that a -run pattern anchored with $ is denied, and give the anchored form to use instead

Evidence: `-run TestRenderCLIViews$` was denied as "can't be checked before it runs", but the plain `-run TestRenderCLIViewsWritesFiles` was allowed
